repository: ShopFlow clean (17 bugs); texts from repair_agent/shopflow_opencode_scenario_en.md; files/symbols from bugs.json buggy_locations (constants have no symbol node)

cases.text: Customer C003 orders 1 MOU-2001 with coupon WELCOME10 and always gets "discount rate out of range". After that error, the "reserved" count of MOU-2001 goes up even though no order was created.

Customer C003 (standard tier) orders 2 KEY-1001 (159.80 USD, 2.4 kg). The quote shows a shipping fee of 244.70 and the tax is also charged on the shipping fee. The order should ship free, with tax 15.98 and total 175.78.
Alice (C001) orders 1 MOU-2001, then Bob (C002) orders 1 CAB-4001. Bob's order also contains Alice's MOU-2001 line, and its subtotal includes the other order's amount.

Order 2 HUB-5001, confirm it, then call POST /orders/<id>/ship: the response is 500 "internal error". Despite the error, the order becomes shipped and the stock has been reduced; afterwards "available" for HUB-5001 is negative.

A shipped order can be cancelled, and the cancellation also puts the items back into stock. Per the specification, shipped is a final state: cancelling a shipped order must raise an invalid-transition error and must not return items to stock.
HUB-5001 has 3 left. A first order for 2 succeeds; a second order for 2 more also succeeds, so the total reserved exceeds the stock.
With build_app(today=lambda: date(2026, 11, 20)) (a Friday), shipping an order gives an expected delivery date of 2026-11-26, one day early, as if Saturday were a business day.
The price 2.675 is rounded to 2.67, but it must be 2.68 (ROUND_HALF_UP).
There are 2 confirmed orders (totals 100 and 50) and 1 pending order. average_order_value returns 50; it should be 75.
GET /products?page=1&size=2 returns only 1 product.
GET /products/XYZ-9999 (a SKU that does not exist) returns 500; it should be 404.
CAB-4001 has exactly 5 available (equal to LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5) but is not in the low-stock list. A product at the threshold must also be listed.
Looking up a customer by the email "ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM" (upper case) does not find Alice.
Registering a customer with the valid email "user+tag@example.com" fails with "invalid email".
Money uses Decimal, rounded ROUND_HALF_UP to 2 decimal places.
The customer-tier discount and the coupon combine multiplicatively, capped at 50%. Coupons in config.COUPONS are stored as percentages.
Shipping is free when the value after discount is >= 100; the 10% tax applies only to the goods after discount, not to the shipping fee.
Placing an order reserves stock; any error while placing an order must release every reservation.
Status flow: pending -> confirmed -> shipped; pending/confirmed -> cancelled. shipped and cancelled are final states.
The expected delivery date counts business days (Monday to Friday).
